metaTitle: Custom Knit Gift Sets & Bundles | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom knit gift sets bundles for bulk orders. Cozy, branded sets perfect for corporate gifts or employee appreciation at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Knit gift sets offer a soft, tactile alternative to standard corporate gifts. Ideal for winter holiday promotions or employee appreciation, these bundles combine warmth with brand visibility. The 3 Piece Knit Set, for example, allows full-color digital decoration across multiple items, giving you a cohesive look that stands out. Choose knit for a gift that feels personal and substantial.
heroAltText: Custom knit gift sets bundles with full color digital print, including a beanie, scarf, and gloves in a branded set.
